digest.component_or_area: ticket state schema and write surfaces
propositions: Add bridge_project (tri-state string) and repos (list of strings) fields to ticket state schema and initial state; project both fields from CREATE and EDIT events in the reducer.
Implement create-time arguments --bridge-project and --repos on all three write surfaces (CLI, library, MCP) that populate the fields in CREATE event data.
Implement edit-time promotion guard on bridge_project preventing modification of already-bound tickets while allowing unbound edits; repos remains freely editable.
Ensure three distinguishable states for bridge_project (absent for legacy, empty string for never-sync, key for sync target) survive replay and are not collapsed to falsy equivalence.
Verify identical ticket state results across CLI, library, and MCP create paths and that pre-feature tickets replay with new fields absent.
